items.text: As a learner, complete a full Korean lesson including listening, speaking, and writing exercises and submit all answers.
items.expected: All answers are saved correctly, progress is updated to reflect lesson completion, and appropriate feedback is provided for each exercise, ensuring accurate tracking of learner's progress.

items.text: As a tutor, assign homework to a learner, then review and provide feedback on submitted work.
items.expected: Homework is successfully assigned to the learner, the learner can submit their work, and tutor feedback appears correctly in the learner's dashboard with notifications sent, ensuring effective tutor-student communication.

items.text: As a speaking partner, start a speaking practice session with a learner, record the session, and provide post-session notes.
items.expected: Session is initiated without errors, audio is recorded and stored securely, and notes are attached to the session log viewable by both speaking partner and learner for continuous improvement.

items.text: As an admin, change the role of a user from learner to tutor, then verify role permissions update accordingly.
items.expected: User role is changed successfully without data loss, the user immediately gains tutor permissions (access to tutor-specific features), and the system logs the role change for audit purposes.

items.text: As an unauthorized visitor (not logged in), attempt to access learner-specific lesson content and tutor dashboards.
items.expected: Access is denied with clear messages prompting login or registration, and no restricted content is exposed, ensuring platform security and proper access control.
